question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Did you try to save Justin the first time through?
Who do you like more, Linda or Denni?

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: They're confused! Nice job!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Everybody get in!

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Perfect!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: They're headed this way!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm okay, guys!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Great! That bought us some time!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Climb over the fence!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Good! Keep following my lead!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Look! I don't listen brains a freshman brains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Zach! What's up with you?!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Brains do you mean? Brains brains brains!

nodes.speaker: Zombie Zach
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He's become a zombie! Run!
The group bolts toward Linda's car!

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh-oh! The other zombies see us!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Quick! Jump between the cars!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Everybody! Look around you!
The parking lot is packed with zombies!

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Quick! Hide behind this tree!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, where's your car, Zach?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: On the other side of that mob of zombies...
Suddenly, Denni shimmies down from the tree!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why don't you take Linda's hybrid?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Where'd you come from?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just hiding from the zombies. They can't climb trees.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: How do you know that?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I've read `Yikes! More Zombies!` like a hundred times...
nodes.text_bbcode: I've read [color=#3b78e2][i]Yikes! More Zombies![/i][/color] like a hundred times...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: They're attracted to loud noises, hate fire, and can't climb trees...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Huh, blank faces. `None` of you are familiar with the `Yikes!` series?
nodes.text_bbcode: Huh, blank faces. [color=#3b78e2][i]None[/i][/color] of you are familiar with the [color=#3b78e2][i]Yikes![/i][/color] series?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Yikes! Home Alone with Gnomes?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yikes! Home Alone with Gnomes?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Or `Yikes! Vampires on Campus?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Or [color=#3b78e2][i]Yikes! Vampires on Campus?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I feel like I needed that one recently... But I can't remember why...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're weird, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Look, can we focus less on me and more on the zombie apocalypse?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: We can't take Linda's car! It's orange!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't see how that matters!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You can't fight zombies in an orange hybrid!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Zach's car is too loud! It'll attract every zombie in the neighborhood! We need to get out of here quietly...
Zach tackles three zombies at once!
Colt leaps! But he flies over the zombies' heads and crashes into Linda!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oooooow! My ankle!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: She's the only one you `weren't` supposed to tackle!
nodes.text_bbcode: She's the only one you [color=#e23b3b][i]weren't[/i][/color] supposed to tackle!

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!
Zach drags everyone out of the cafeteria...
And into the parking lot...
They rush forward!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: All right! Just remember to aim below the waist, make contact with your shoulder, and drive with your legs.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Zach, give me some of whatever it is you're eating...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Now is not the time to think about food!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: To distract them, dummy!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, zombies! Braaaaains!
Colt throws Zach's food to the far end of the cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It worked! The zombies took the bait!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That was `too` close.
nodes.text_bbcode: That was [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] close.

nodes.text: Linda jumps down from the table...
And they run out into the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Let's tackle them. It'll be just like football!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're the only one here who `plays` football.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're the only one here who [color=#e23b3b][i]plays[/i][/color] football.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We could try distracting them somehow...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: But tackling's easy. Just brains the brains brains.
Zach takes another bite of his food...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: 'Brains the brains brains?'

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Woah! Keep talking like a zombie, man, and I'll punch you, I swear!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But, you...

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: They're getting closer!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, we've gotta keep moving...
They cut through the cafeteria...
And find Linda standing on a table surrounded by zombies!

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: `Help!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Help![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Anybody got any ideas?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, these things are interested in brains, right? Between the three of us, who are they going to go after first?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Good point.
Zach punches the locker open.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: How'd you end up in there, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I stuffed myself in. I deduced that the probability of a zombie learning the intricacies of locker manipulation was minuscule at best.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You know, I could stuff him back in...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hey! Let me out!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You'll need me! By the end of all this, you'll need me!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Shut up, brains-for-brains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Something wrong? You keep saying 'brains'...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: No, I don't.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: These guys are acting just like the zombies in those stupid movies Sammy used to drag me to...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh!
Colt races back to the nurse's office and slams the door behind him!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Zombies!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Zombies![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The undeniable sound of chewing comes from behind a nearby door...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gulp. I'll just nudge the door open a crack...
Zach is there, munching on some food... Colt steps in.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey, new guy!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Phew! Zach, right? We've got a problem...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I know! The nurse said she'd be brains like `two` hours ago.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know! The nurse said she'd be brains like [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] hours ago.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Forget about the... Wait, what'd you just say?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: The nurse... She said she'd be back like an hour ago.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: And I've been feeling so `weird.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And I've been feeling so [color=#e23b3b][i]weird.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh well...
Zach resumes munching on his food...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You know, this is good. But it's no Centerscore donut. Wish I had one now...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You don't understand... There are `zombies` in the hallway!
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't understand... There are [color=#e23b3b][i]zombies[/i][/color] in the hallway!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Z-Z-Zombies?! What do we do?
Colt and Zach creep by the zombies in the hall...

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Psst... It's just like 'Left for Bread!'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shh!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: My car's this way, in the parking lot.
A banging sound comes from a nearby locker...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hey! Help me out! I'm in here! I'm stuck in this locker!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We should free him...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Wait. I know this nerd. He is really annoying... You sure we want him along?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I can `hear` you!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can [color=#e23b3b][i]hear[/i][/color] you!

nodes.text: The figure stops and turns around, limping back down the hall...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Guess he wants me to follow him...
Colt turns the corner and finds the hallway filled with identical figures...

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!
The figure keeps lurching forward...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! You deaf or something?!

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That is getting annoying!
Another figure, identical to the first, appears around the corner, lurching the same way...

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What the...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: If you don't know it, just say 'Uncle'!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That's it! Anyone so clever is a friend to Monte-Carlos!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That's it! Anyone so clever is a friend to Monte-Carlos!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt! That's not funny! We're trying to convince him we're `not` zombies!
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt! That's not funny! We're trying to convince him we're [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] zombies!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What kind of idiot do you take me for? Making the password my own name!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Although it does start with the same letter...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Wait! I've said too much!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You think I'd make the password 'Password'?! This isn't a two-bit operation!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: It's a well-oiled machine, a well-groomed m...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I almost said it. But you can't trick Monte!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Let me tell you about zombies, son!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I remember it like it was yesterday... It was the summer of my fifteenth year...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: The third anniversary of my moustache...
Three minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And that's why 'Zombies' can never be my password!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Let me tell you about zombies, son!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I remember it like it was yesterday... It was the summer of my fifteenth year...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: The third anniversary of my moustache...
Three minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And that's why 'Zombie' can never be my password!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That's where you'd still be if it were up to me! You think I didn't recognize the voice of the legendary Shoemaker?!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I told you, the password's got squat to do with donuts!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: They're going to break through that table!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You have to let us up!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Fine! But don't make any sudden movements, or I'll haul you to Boot Camp faster than a badger in a muskrat tunnel!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Is that even a phrase?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Why would $MONTEPASSWORD be my password?! Get your head on straight!
The latch opens.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Everybody up!
They scramble onto the roof!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We know a place we can go where we'll be safe. A boarding school.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Sounds secure. I've tied a bunch of clothes together into a rope. We can climb down and take my car.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Good. We've been riding through the zombie apocalypse in a total chick-mobile.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, you're alive, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Alive and embarrassed.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: There's no worries with my car.
They climb down the rope of clothes and rush to Officer Monte's car.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Psst... That's enough! Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay! Good job!

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Wait! It doesn't matter! We don't have Justin!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Um... We need Justin?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Yeah... This was Justin's area of expertise...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do we do then?

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: We survive...
Months later...

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Woof!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shh... Puddles, be quiet!

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Woof.
Colt reaches out for a bag of chips...
The bag crinkles.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sigh.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Run, Puddles, Run!

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Ruuuuff!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Start the car! Start the car!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Everybody in!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Still no chips...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I think I'd rather have traded Justin for zombies...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Especially if it meant being able to eat just one more bag of chips!
No chips for Colt! It looks like Justin was right! Humanity did need him in the end!
Play again and see if you can help Colt keep Justin out of the hands of the zombies!
And see what kind of Mystery Mystery awaits you in the bonus scene...
Or check out the latest Premium Content for Halloween! See what's spooky at Centerscore University!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I am.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What?! What happened to not eating anything served with a ladle?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Like you guys were going to trust me knowing I could turn into a zombie at any moment!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: We don't have time for bickering! The point is: `you're immune!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We don't have time for bickering! The point is: [color=#3b78e2][i]you're immune![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Denni, I think they're working on a cure for zombieism!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: So if we can isolate the compounds in Mystery Mystery...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: We can use the blood of someone immune to create an antidote, essentially.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: There must be `someone` immune to Mystery Mystery!
nodes.text_bbcode: There must be [color=#e23b3b][i]someone[/i][/color] immune to Mystery Mystery!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, you saved Puddles?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I was looking for you...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Denni, come check out what these guys are working on over here...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Denni?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Brains!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, are you hearing all this?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Grab something fancy to use as repellant, and follow me.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Brains brains brains going?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Looks like we're about to be on the run again...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Braaaaains!
Uh-oh! Colt and Denni on the run once again!
Kind of a bleak future, don't you think?
Play again and see if you can stop the zombie apocalypse from happening!
Or check out the latest Premium Content for Halloween! See what's spooky at Centerscore University!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: Many find those who are special to them...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Raven!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Denni! You made it!
Raven and Denni hug each other tight!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hello there, ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm sorry. Have we met?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: We... We...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'm Officer Monte.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Principal Shapiro.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You can let go of my hand!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh. Sorry, ma'am. Principal. Ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Woof! Woof!

nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: Meow!

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Woof!

nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: Purrrrrrr!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Puddles! You're okay!

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Woof!
Puddles jogs over to Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How did you get here, boy?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Sammy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt!
Colt hugs Sam...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Finally. We're safe.
As the weeks pass, those who avoid the zombies straggle their way to Monarch Prep...
Many of them were unwillingly put to work by Principal Whitford...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: How dare she make us work in the kitchen!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I'm not roasting `any` birds!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not roasting [color=#3b78e2][i]any[/i][/color] birds!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Plus, now our army of attack pheasants will keep us safe from the zombies!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: You think they'll notice the switch?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It's all meat, right?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Is Mystery Mystery even meat?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Who knows?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: This duck is exquisite! It's very... How do the French put it? Brains!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: There's a marriage of flavors that brains on the tongue.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Mmmm! Brains!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: These brains aren't going to brain themselves, that's for brains!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: No doubt you have acquired what you believe is food...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: But inside these walls, we only eat what royalty eats!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: A rule that is in effect regardless of the unimportant goings-on out-of-doors.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Good day to you all!
Principal Whitford locks the door behind her.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: She's worse than the zombies!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We don't have anywhere else to go...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Good night, Madisenn.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Good night, Pen.
The window slides open!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: A burglar! Quick! Let me put my diamonds in your safe!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ladies...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: `Noooooooooo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Noooooooooo![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The group members stumble in...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Whatever are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Lady, look!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Zombies, you say? I assumed they were panhandlers...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I suppose we can use more help here...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Very well... Come on in, just try not to breathe on anything...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait... You have to let us in!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And why must I do that?
The car idles up to the front of Monarch Prep...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We made it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Check it out...
A line of zombies lurches toward Monarch Prep, but is continuously repulsed, as if by an invisible force field!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I guess it doesn't get more opulent than this place.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: All we have to do is get through this line of zombies...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey... Isn't that...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Amanda! Get out of there!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, hey guys! Look at me, I'm a nerd! Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Amanda! They're going to get you!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's okay! For some reason, they're not interested in me!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: She's fine! Let's go!
They plow through the line of zombies and up the steps of Monarch Prep!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That was easy!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And where do you think you're going?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh-oh!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: 'Uh-oh' is the correct response to the current situation...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I am Principal Whitford. What I allow inside my school are dignified, austere young ladies.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: What I don't allow inside my school `are` ratty filth-ridden boys...
nodes.text_bbcode: What I don't allow inside my school [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] ratty filth-ridden boys...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Undignified, tree-climbing females who believe black is a color to be worn liberally...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Any adult male who is over-proudly moustachioed!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And slobber-mouthed dogs!

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Roooowowowowwwwrrrr...
Puddles slumps onto his side...

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Braaaaains!
The zombie bites Colt's hand!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ow!
Colt slugs the zombie in the face!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, Puddles!
They rush back into the car.

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Roooowowowowwwwrrrr...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's not helping, dog.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You okay, sonny?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I think so... It just hurt a lot.

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Ruff! Ruff!
Puddles starts gnawing on the zombie's leg!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Braaaaains!
Colt leaps into the car!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Here, Puddles!
Puddles bounds into the car, as the zombie falls to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Good boy!

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Ruff!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's stop. If Raven lived around here, I'd want to stop for her, too...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait here...
Colt knocks on the front door to Sam's house... It creaks open...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: H-Hello? Sammy? Sammy's Mom?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know you hate me, but FYI, there's a zombie apocalypse, and I wanted to see if you were okay...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sammy?
Something rustles in the corner...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gulp...

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Ruff!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Puddles!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, let's get outta here!
Colt and Puddles run back to the car.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Puddles...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, we had to bail.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: At least we've still got the donuts!
Monte drives off!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Did you guys get the food?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, we had to bail.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: At least we've still got the donuts...
Colt helps Linda up...
...And they scramble away with the zombie mob right on their heels!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Go! Go! Go!
The group scrambles into the car, and Monte floors it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Did you guys get the food?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Brains are you going?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Don't leave brains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're turning into one of them!
Colt sprints out front to the car!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We've gotta go! Everyone in!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Where's Linda?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Um... She sacrificed herself for me.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A true hero!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I would have done the same for her in the reverse situation.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No you wouldn't have! You locked us all out of the theater because you thought we were all going to become zombies!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I've changed!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That was like twenty minutes ago!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: They know we're here!
The zombies lurch toward Colt and Linda!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Forget the food! Run!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, Linda.
Colt and Linda walk away from the group...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Listen, Colt. I never got a chance to say brains for trying to save me.
Colt stops in his tracks!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What did you just say?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Thanks for trying to save me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Linda, did you lie about eating Mystery Mystery?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: How? I-I didn't know what it was, honest. Zach handed me some; he told me it was tofurkey. How did you know?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nothing. No reason. Just a guess.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Please don't tell anyone. If brains find out, they'll brains me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I won't.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's get moving.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's dark in here.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let me find a light switch...
Linda flips on the light...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So many zombies!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: They haven't seen us yet, and we still need food...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Remember, they're attracted to loud noises... Grab only `quiet` foods!
nodes.text_bbcode: Remember, they're attracted to loud noises... Grab only [color=#e23b3b][i]quiet[/i][/color] foods!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's okay. We could probably use more normal people food, anyway.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Like some chips...
Monte coasts his car into a gas station.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: All right. Assignments. I'll pump gas. Bonnie, you get food. Clyde, go with her. Mini-Bonnie, you're on windshield detail.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I think I'm mini-Bonnie...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, this is the same kinda car Linda drives!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ha! Still think it's a chick-mobile?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Do you enjoy bothering me?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: It's perfect against a zombie onslaught! Low noise emission, and orange is the most lawful color. The nearly unlimited fuel tank reduces the need for...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'm... I'm nearly out of gas.
The zombies surround the party!

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: I don't suppose anyone has a torch in their pocket...

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Any final thoughts from anyone?

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Yes...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now that I'm face-to-face with impending doom, I finally realize, between Howard and Kenji, to whom my heart truly belongs...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Who?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Braaaaains!
The zombie mob descends upon the party!
What unfortunate timing!
You couldn't get Colt and the party through the zombie apocalypse!
Try again and see if you can get Colt out of the parking lot and into safety!
Or check out the latest Premium Content for Halloween! See what's spooky at Centerscore University!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: Colt and Linda sneak back out of the shop...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey everyone, we've gotta go `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey everyone, we've gotta go [color=#e23b3b][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: There are a million zombies in there!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You kids know what's turning people into zombies?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: One of our brains kept saying brains brains...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: She's one of them!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Braaaaains!
Monte slams on the brakes!
Linda grabs the donuts and leaps out of the car with them, disappearing into the night.
All is quiet...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This is the worst day of my life...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Come on!
As the group nears Monarch Prep, they pass a familiar park...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait... We have to stop somewhere first...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Itinerary does not include wanton stop-offs for troublemaking in the park!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No... Sam's house is nearby... She could be in danger.

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: As the car heads toward Monarch Prep, night falls...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You kids know what's turning people into zombies?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: One of our brains kept saying brains brains...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: She's one of them!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Braaaaains!
Monte slams on the brakes!
Linda grabs Justin and leaps out of the car with him!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No! Help! You need me! You need meeeeeeee!
All is quiet...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Bright side? No more Justin!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's true!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Come on!
Just then, Linda falls!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: My ankle!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Make a lot of noise! Distract the zombies!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: My car's right over there!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The zombies are going to swarm us if we don't split up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, follow me! Linda head that way!

nodes.title: Halloween: In Colt Blood, Chapter One
nodes.subtitle: Last Day of School...

nodes.text: It's Halloween! Welcome to a spooky episode of Surviving High School...
Today, you'll be playing as Colt. See if you can help him survive Halloween!
Colt wakes up...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Blech. Should never have eaten so much Mystery Mystery...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Where'd the nurse go?
Colt rolls off the table and steps into the hall...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come to think of it, where'd `everyone` go?
nodes.text_bbcode: Come to think of it, where'd [color=#e23b3b][i]everyone[/i][/color] go?

nodes.text: An odd-looking figure lurches around the corner...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's he supposed to be? Some kind of mime?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's a lame Halloween costume.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! You! Where is everyone?

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I get it. You're really smart.
The figure limps toward Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, pal, can you give me a straight answer?

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How do I get through to this nerd?!

options.label: Where is the location of our fleet?

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!
Colt scampers away and catches up to the group!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ideas?! She's a goner! Let her fend for herself!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You mean like how we let you fend for yourself?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: A valid point.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'll just supervise from back here, guys.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: We tackle as a team!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I don't even know what trajectory to set my course for...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just wing it. Let's go!
Justin falls down immediately...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We?! This party is big enough as it is. We don't have room for a fifth!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If we ditch anyone, it's gonna be you!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh, then, the more the merrier.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Justin, follow Linda!
A zombie throws Colt to the pavement!

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!
Colt scampers away and catches up to the group!
Colt flips over a table and covers up the hole.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: There's a hatch to the roof, but it's locked!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We're stuck?
A voice blares through an intercom...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: This is Officer Monte! I'm on the roof! I'll open the hatch for you, but only if you can tell me the password!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I can't let up any zombies, and I can't let up any low-brow Bonnie and Clydes either! Not one of you has a moustache!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But we have sacks filled with donuts!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Mmmm... I wish that were the password... But it isn't.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'll give you as many guesses as you want...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This way! There's access to the roof!
They climb up a ladder into a small custodial room.
They knife through the growing mass of zombies and into the arcade!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The zombies are still chasing us! They're attracted to all the arcade noise!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aaaaaahhhhh!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Genius choice! We have to get out of the mall! There are too many zombies here!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's try to get to the roof! I think we can get there through the theater!
They knife through the growing mass of zombies and into the jewelry department!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It worked!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's like they're repelled by opulence...
Colt picks up a note from one of the display cases.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: 'If you want admission, you'll have to keep a stiff upper lip.'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Admission? Like a ticket?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The movie theater! I bet we can get to the roof and get out of here through the theater...
The group steamrolls a path to the theater...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: They've found us!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We've got to make a run for it `now,` guys!
nodes.text_bbcode: We've got to make a run for it [color=#3b78e2][i]now,[/i][/color] guys!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let's pick a place and go!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We have to make a final donut run!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: She's right! I need one last donut...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We can't risk it! There are probably a million zombies at the mall! I'm putting my foot down. We're not going for donuts, girls!
At the donut shop in the mall...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hrmph.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey! Look at this! It's a diary!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: '1:15 PM. Zombies everywhere. They have no respect for the law. Have begun to protect what matters most to me. Centerscore donuts aren't going to protect themselves.'

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: '2:12 PM. Nothing better than eating donuts while on duty. Moustache smells like jelly and chocolate frosting.'

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: '2:20 PM. Getting pretty sick from donuts. Zombies outnumber me. But I know their weakness. They can't stand gold...' It ends there.
Denni picks something up off the ground.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I... I can't tell you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What?! Why not?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You ate Mystery Mystery... You could turn into a zombie at any moment.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's ridiculous! Even if I did, it's not like I'm going to remember that note when I'm mindless.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And how do we know that?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The same way we know that zombies can't climb trees...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are you making fun of me?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Guys, focus...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's a note in the same handwriting!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It says, 'The only magic word I know is a hairy one.'

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Whatever that means...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: According to this note, the zombies can't stand 'gold' `something.` What could that mean?
nodes.text_bbcode: According to this note, the zombies can't stand 'gold' [color=#3b78e2][i]something.[/i][/color] What could that mean?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It could mean 'gold', like the jewelry department...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This is just like that detective video game I've been playing, `Cause of Death!`...  You follow a story and make choices. It's really fun!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is just like that detective video game I've been playing, [color=#3b78e2][i]Cause of Death![/i][/color]...  You follow a story and make choices. It's really fun!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I guess it could be the beginning of a video game title... Like `Golden Wax.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess it could be the beginning of a video game title... Like [color=#e23b3b][i]Golden Wax.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So... Where should I be driving us?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How about Wilson High?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Good idea, but they serve Mystery Mystery, too. Only theirs is called Riddle Riddle.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We need to go somewhere where no one would even conceive of Mystery Mystery let alone eat it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Monarch Prep! The only mystery there is all the fancy couches in the girls' bathroom...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How do you know there are couches in the `girls' bathroom?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: How do you know there are couches in the [color=#3b78e2][i]girls' bathroom?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Can we focus less on me and more on the zombie apocalypse?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You can't use my line like that!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why not? It worked when you said it...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hmph.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, fair enough.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's go to Monarch Prep...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: There's one hitch... They only eat rich people food there.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So, what's the problem?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: None... As long as you're cool with eating caviar, duck liver, snails, and frog legs for as long as we have to hide for...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yuck.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Doesn't sound too bad...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No more chips, no hot dogs, no sodas.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: A sacrifice we'll have to make...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No more Centerscore donuts.
Linda slams on the brakes!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Don't` joke about that.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Don't[/i][/color] joke about that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, like I'm gonna eat something that gets served with a ladle.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Real classy. Okay, then, none of us had Mystery Mystery, none of us are zombies. It's not exactly proof, but it's a strong case.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, I'm `not` turning into a zombie. You believe me, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] turning into a zombie. You believe me, right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I... I did.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I haven't been saying 'brains' the way Zach was...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What about you? Did you eat any, Colt?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: From the moment I met up with him, he was eating something, and I think I know what it was...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Mystery Mystery!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are you saying...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Did anyone else eat Mystery Mystery today?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I didn't. I brought my lunch from home.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm a vegetarian.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Braaaaains!
They pile into the car and drive off just before the zombies reach them!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We made it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Except for Zach...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I should have known. He kept saying brains...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We all want what we don't have.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm the Vice President. I don't have to eat cafeteria food.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Shouldn't you be stuffed in a locker somewhere?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Can we keep the car `moving` during the zombie apocalypse?
nodes.text_bbcode: Can we keep the car [color=#e23b3b][i]moving[/i][/color] during the zombie apocalypse?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Classic first person RPG snowboarder.
Justin opens the door...
And closes it shut behind him, locking everyone else out!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Justin! Let us in! They're coming!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No! You're all going to become zombies, anyway!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We're `not,` Justin! None of us ate Mystery Mystery!
nodes.text_bbcode: We're [color=#3b78e2][i]not,[/i][/color] Justin! None of us ate Mystery Mystery!

nodes.text: Colt takes a step back... And kicks in the door!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm sorry! I-I don't know what came over me!
Colt lifts Justin up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uhf!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Thanks... I know you had plenty of reason not to do that...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We can't trust you anymore.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You'll need me! By the end of this, you'll need me!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You're really just going to leave him?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: In `Yikes! More Zombies!`, they say that abandoning a party member is one of the `worst` things you can do.
nodes.text_bbcode: In [color=#3b78e2][i]Yikes! More Zombies![/i][/color], they say that abandoning a party member is one of the [color=#3b78e2][i]worst[/i][/color] things you can do.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I'm doing it. We can't have someone in the party we can't trust!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Help! A zombie's got my leg!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why should I help `you?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Why should I help [color=#e23b3b][i]you?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You can't leave him!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, he's annoying, but it's still wrong!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm losing my grip!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: He tried to lock us all out!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You just said it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shut up.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He's right, you did.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What?! How could you be so careless?!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Don't make me come back there, nasal twerp!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What about me?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Just sit there!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's sneak around the back...
They turn the corner, and find themselves face-to-face with a zombie mob!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Quick! Run!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aaahh!
Linda slips!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh brains brains brains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Go around the back!
As they race out the back, Linda slips!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh brains brains brains!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I veto this stopping idea. By now, she's already a zombie!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This isn't stupid student council!
Whitford gives Justin a quick once-over.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Shudder.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Psst, Colt. It brains like everyone's turning into a brains!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Everyone has someone but me...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The dog...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Even Colt...

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Justin!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: You made it!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: We've been trying to work out this equation regarding zombie population expansion, but...

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: We're lost without your complex number theory! Come check out our data!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, everyone, help yourself to a Centerscore donut!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Is that what you call these round bringers of ecstasy?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh... Yes, but your name works just as well!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt is!
A nearly perfect one!

nodes.text: I can make a cure.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's something in you, Colt. In your blood...
Weeks later, life is somewhat back-to-normal at Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Give me your lunch money now, or I'll stuff you into your locker again!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But I saved humanity!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let him go!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: He owes me lunch money already.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Oh, I didn't know. Sorry, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: You should have said something, lint-face.
Travis storms off.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Thanks, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're even.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But I saved you from a miserable existence for the rest of your life... And you saved me from Travis for only one...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Even!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Got it. Even, Steven.
Zach clamps his hand on Colt's shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey, Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aaaah!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Why are you so jumpy?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh. Nothing. No reason. How do you feel?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: It's weird, man. I remember seeing you at the nurse's office.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: And then, I just blanked. But now I feel so `rested.`

nodes.text: `No!`

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Dude! I was eating that sandwich!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry. I hate... Bread.
Monte clamps his hand on Colt's shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Aaaah!` I wish that would stop!

nodes.text: Good news, son! All traces of Mystery Mystery have been completely eliminated!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Things are back to normal, eh?

nodes.text: It looks that way!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What does this mean for us?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Nothing! I see you committing a felony, it's a fun-way ticket to Boot Camp!
Now things are truly back to normal!
You helped Colt save Justin, and in turn, prevented the zombie apocalypse!
Congratulations on playing such a great game!
A perfect one! Here's your bonus scene!
As Monte starts to pull away in his hybrid... Colt races out of the school!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait! Wait!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What is it, Colt?

nodes.text: You got rid of all the Mystery Mystery... But did you get rid of Riddle Riddle, too?
